schema.id: string — unique source id, e.g. IK-001
schema.root: string — Arabic root, e.g. ر ح م
schema.word_ar: string — the word as it appears in the ayah
schema.source: string — book/edition of Tafsir Ibn Kathir
schema.location: string — volume/page where the meaning appears
schema.meaning_ar: string — meaning quoted exactly from the source
schema.meaning_en: string — English meaning for the child/parent
schema.status: string — draft (entered, not reviewed) | approved (reviewed by Sara, matches the source) | rejected
